entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh, are you a fan of this store too?

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: This shop's customized guns are in a[n]league of their own. I get excited just[n]by looking at them.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Some people who look like they might[n]be detectives have been coming to the[n]shop lately...

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I think a lot of customers are holding[n]off on customizations so the cops won't[n]notice them.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Personally, I don't really mind. I'm not[n]doing anything shady, anyway.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Think you could ask them for some info...?

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh man, you hear about the[n][clr 4]Makaranov[clr 27] coming out soon?

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: When it comes to automatics, you can't[n]go wrong with this!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait to get my hands on a[n][clr 4]Makaranov[clr 27]! Man, being patient[n]is rough.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: You know that capsule machine?[n]The one with army rations[n]over by the entrance?

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Apparently, those rations are really gross.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: And it's not just the flavor. There's...[n]a lot about it that's gross.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: They're too pricey for me, and also[n]maybe too risky, but if you're curious,[n]why not give them a try?

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh, man, I'm so hyped about the new[n]model coming out in July...

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: You hear about it? It's called the [clr 4]Tarantula[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: People made a big deal about it, but the[n]rapid-fire mechanism was too complex[n]for a model version...

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: ...Until now! They're finally making one![n]I've waited for this for so long!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: It's been so long, I almost tried making[n]it myself! But no, I don't have the skills[n]for that.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait to have my own [clr 4]Tarantula[clr 27]![n]Man, being patient is rough.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh man, September's new model is[n]gonna be awesome! It's a revolver[n]called [clr 4]Wildborn[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: It'd be great if those Phantom Thieves[n]everyone's talking about used guns as[n]stylish as this.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Though, would they even use guns?[n]I have no clue.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait to spin the barrel of that[n][clr 4]Wildborn[clr 27]! Man, being patient is rough.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh, man, I'm so looking forward to the[n][clr 4]Fury[clr 27] coming out in October!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: It's a reprint model! I can't even sleep,[n]I'm so excited! I... I've got a gun replica[n]addiction.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I almost wish those Phantom[n]Thieves everyone's talking about[n]would steal my addiction away.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait to practice my fast draw[n]with it! Man, being patient is rough!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh, man, I am stoked about the [clr 4]Hizutsu[clr 27][n]coming out in November!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: They announced that they were making[n]it a while back, but it got delayed for[n]some reason.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I thought maybe the Phantom Thieves[n]stole the plans, or something like that[n]happened.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: And then, just as I was wondering[n]all of that...

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: They announce the release date![n]Those guys really know how to[n]string us along.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait till I can go to bed, cradling it in[n]my arms! Man, being patient is rough.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I'm pretty curious about the [clr 4]R.I.Pistol[clr 27][n]coming out at the end of the year.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: It looks simple, but maybe... It's also[n]got hidden depths?

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait to pose in the mirror with that[n][clr 4]R.I.Pistol[clr 27]! Man, being patient is rough.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh man, I'm super interested in[n]that [clr 4][var 5][clr 27] coming out[n]at the end of the year.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: What? It's armor, man. In these crazy[n]times, I need some extra protection[n]to survive.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't wait to admire[n]my [clr 4][var 5][clr 27]! Man,[n]being patient is rough.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I'm really curious about the [clr 4]Milkor[clr 27][n]coming out at the end of the year.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I always spend a lot around the year's end.[n]I can't wait until the new year is here!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Man, being patient is rough. But I guess[n]self-control is pretty important around[n]New Year's.

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: Oh man, I can't recommend the[n][clr 4]Yellow Girl[clr 27] that came out at the start[n]of this year enough!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: The way you reload it is so freaking cool!

entries.speaker: Military Buff
entries.en: I can't believe I'll be able to get my[n]hands on that model. Life is too great...

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: [lName]-san! I'm glad I could see[n]you!

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: Dad told me today's your last day here,[n]so I really needed to talk to you...
Thanks.
Calm down.
What's wrong?

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: No, I should be thanking you...! I just[n]had to tell you this in person!

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: Oh! Sorry... I just had to tell you this[n]in person!

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: Starting this spring, I'll be a Shujin student!

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: I know I said I admired the Phantom[n]Thieves, but I think you're amazing too,[n][lName]-san...

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: I want to be just like you. I figured I could[n]start by going to the same school as you.
Good luck.
So you're my junior?

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: Thanks... Oh, shoot! I forgot I was in[n]charge of dinner today...!

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: Sorry, I've gotta go. Gotta catch a sale[n]before it ends... Talk to you later!
